svg.title: Pending against verified UK woodland carbon units
svg.desc: At 31 March 2026 the UK Land Carbon Registry held 14,171,000 Pending Issuance Units, promises of future carbon, against 12,700 verified Woodland Carbon Units. Fewer than one in a thousand units is verified; only verified units can be counted against UK emissions.
svg.text: UK woodland carbon: promised versus delivered
Units on the UK Land Carbon Registry at 31 March 2026 (Woodland Carbon Code statistics).
Fewer than 1 in 1,000 units is verified. Only verified units can be counted against UK emissions today.
